summary: 减少肉食能减轻土地、氮排放等方面的环境压力，但全面放弃畜牧也会影响不适合耕种的土地利用、动物副产品和部分家庭的营养及生计。文章据此比较减量与降低生产环境成本的选择。
logic: 畜牧的土地与排放成本
评估低环境成本的生产方式

paragraphs.brief: 去年，世界消费了2.89亿吨肉、7亿吨牛奶和12亿个鸡蛋。
sentences: The call for people to eat less meat to save the planet is growing louder, so if less is good, wouldn’t none be better?
让人们少吃肉来拯救地球的呼声越来越响，所以，如果少吃肉是好的，是不是没有比这更好的？
To find out, let’s imagine what would happen if the world eliminated meat, milk and eggs from its diet, then trace the effects.
想想如果世界从饮食中消除了肉、牛奶和鸡蛋，并追踪其影响，会发生什么。
Last year the world consumed 289 million tonnes of meat, 700 million tonnes of milk and 1.2 billion eggs.
去年，世界消费了2.89亿吨肉、7亿吨牛奶和12亿个鸡蛋。
Environmentally speaking, this came at an enormous cost.
就环境而言，这是代价巨大的。

paragraphs.brief: 总之，如果我们改吃素食，也就是说没有肉、奶或鸡蛋，目前种植作物所需的土地估计将减少21%，大约340万公顷，大约相当于印度面积。
sentences: All agriculture damages the environment.
所有农业都会破坏环境。
Take for example the felled forests and the common use of irrigation systems.
例如，砍伐森林和共同使用灌溉系统。
And it may surprise you to know that agriculture creates more greenhouse gases than all methods of transport put together.
农业产生的温室气体超过所有运输方法的总和可能会令你感到惊讶
Livestock farming does the most damage.
畜牧业造成的破坏最大。
In part, that is because most livestock eat grain that could be used to feed human populations, and farmers are forced to grow more than we would otherwise need to meet the demand.
部分原因是，大多数牲畜都吃可用来养活人类的谷物，农民被迫种植的粮食超过我们本来需要的粮食。

Altogether, if we switched to a vegan diet, meaning no meat, dairy or eggs, the land currently required for crops would drop by an estimated 21 per cent, about 3.4 million hectares, roughly the size of India.
总之，如果我们改吃素食，也就是说没有肉、奶或鸡蛋，目前种植作物所需的土地估计将减少21%，大约340万公顷，大约相当于印度面积。

paragraphs.brief: 减少畜牧业也会减少对环境的影响，其中一个影响是农业过程排放的氮，这种氮会扩散到水路和土地。
sentences: One environmental impact that would also lessen through a reduction in animal farming would be that of the nitrogen emitted from agricultural processes, which spreads into both waterways and land.
减少畜牧业也会减少对环境的影响，其中一个影响是农业过程排放的氮，这种氮会扩散到水路和土地。
According to environmental scientist Allison Leach, if everyone eliminated dairy products and eggs, this kind of pollution would fall by 60%.
环境科学家Allison Leach说，如果每个人都把奶制品和蛋除掉，这种污染就会减少60%。
Livestock production has another serious environmental impact.
畜牧业生产对环境产生另一个严重影响。
Global statistics are hard to come by, but in the US at least, livestock account for 55% of erosion, mostly from forests being cut down to make way for grazing land.
全球统计数字很难找到，但至少在美国，牲畜占侵蚀的55%，大部分来自砍伐森林，为放牧土地铺路。
On top of this, half of all antibiotics manufactured are fed to livestock as part of their normal diet, a practice that is leading to drug-resistant bacteria.
除此之外，生产的所有抗生素有一半作为正常饮食的一部分，被喂养给牲畜，这种做法导致产生抗药细菌。

paragraphs.brief: 一个没有肉的世界，那么在许多方面会更加绿色。
sentences: A meat-free world, then would be greener in many ways.
一个没有肉的世界，那么在许多方面会更加绿色。
However, if everyone opted to give up meat there would be significant costs too.
但是，如果每个人都选择放弃肉类，费用也会很高。
For most of human history, livestock grazed on land that wasn’t suitable for ploughing, and in doing so they converted inedible grass into edible meat and milk.
在人类历史的大部分时期，牲畜一直在不适合耕种的土地上放牧，把人们不能吃的草转化为可食用的肉和奶。
Even today, a flock of sheep or goats can be the most efficient way to get food from marginal land.
即使在今天，羊群或山羊也可以成为从边远土地上获取食物的最有效方式。
In a world in which over a billion people do not have enough to eat, using this land for crop production would contribute to food insecurity.
在一个有10亿多人没有足够的食物的世界中，利用这片土地生产作物，将造成粮食无保障。

paragraphs.brief: 例如，在当今世界的一些地区，象鸡一样的牲畜可以靠剩菜和它们发现的东西生存。
sentences: In some parts of the world today, livestock like chickens, for instance, can subsist on leftovers and whatever they find.
例如，在当今世界的一些地区，象鸡一样的牲畜可以靠剩菜和它们发现的东西生存。
Tara Garnett, who heads the Food Climate Research Network at the University of Surrey, points out the usefulness of these animals.
指出这些动物的用处：“Tara Garnett，萨里大学食品气候研究网络负责人。”
By giving them your leftovers, she says, they deal with your rubbish, and you get meat.
她说，他们处理你的垃圾，你得到肉：“给他们你的剩菜。”

Garnett admits, though, that if this kind of approach were generally adopted, it would require a major adjustment in food preferences; people would have to get used to chicken, for example, with less fat.
然而，Garnett承认，如果普遍采用这种方式，就需要对食物偏好作重大调整；人们必须习惯养鸡，例如养少脂肪。

paragraphs.brief: 动物副产品消失是无肉世界的另一个不利因素。
sentences: Another downside to a meat-free world would be the disappearance of animal by-products.
动物副产品消失是无肉世界的另一个不利因素。
Such a world would have to replace the 11 million tonnes of leather and 2 million tonnes of wool that come annually from livestock farming and which are turned into clothing.
这样一个世界必须取代每年来自畜牧业的1 100万吨皮革和200万吨羊毛，这些羊毛变成了服装。
Furthermore, even ardent vegetarians acknowledge that dairy products and meat may be a good thing in poorer countries.
此外，即使是热心的素食者也承认，乳制品和肉类在较贫穷的国家可能是一件好事。

‘Whilst there’s no doubt that considerable reduction of meat consumption would have an environmental benefit, we do have to be careful about saying it would be the best solution if the whole world went vegetarian,’ says Annette Pinner, chief executive of the UK Vegetarian Society.
英国蔬菜协会的首席执行官安妮特·平纳：“虽然毫无疑问大量减少肉类消费会给环境带来好处，但我们确实必须小心地说，如果全世界都吃素的话，这将是最好的解决办法。”
For many of the world’s poorest rural residents, an animal may represent their only realistic hope for a little extra income, and a little animal protein can make a big difference to a marginal diet.
对于世界上许多最贫穷的农村居民来说，动物可能是他们唯一现实的希望，希望得到一点额外的收入，而一点动物蛋白质可以对边际饮食产生很大影响。

paragraphs.brief: 如果我们决定吃不吃肉的素食而不是吃素的呢？
sentences: What if we decided on a no-meat vegetarian diet, rather than a vegan diet?
如果我们决定吃不吃肉的素食而不是吃素的呢？
After all, milk and eggs are very efficient ways of producing animal calories.
毕竟，牛奶和鸡蛋是生产动物卡路里的有效方法。
‘It’s difficult to switch to a no-meat-but-milk diet,’ says Helmut Haberl, a social ecologist.
Helmut Haberl说社会生态学家：“很难改吃不吃麦片的饮食。”
‘Dairy cows must calve every year to keep producing milk, and only half their offspring will be female.
养牛要养牛才能继续产奶只有一半的后代是女性
While many vegetarians see moral reasons not to kill and eat the males, there is surely no practical reason to waste so much meat.’
虽然许多素食者认为有道德理由不杀死和吃掉雄性，但确实没有实际的理由浪费这么多肉。
Similar arguments apply to chickens kept for eggs.
类似的论点也适用于为鸡蛋保存的鸡。

paragraphs.brief: 最直截了当的方法是假设世界将继续想要更多的肉。
sentences: So even though a meat-free world sounds good on paper, it is likely that a utopian future will still have some animal products in it.
因此，即使一个没有肉的世界在纸面上听起来不错，乌托邦的未来可能还会有一些动物产品。
The real questions, then, are how much meat do we want, and how will we produce it?
那么真正的问题是，我们想要多少肉，我们如何生产？
The answers depend on how you approach these questions.
答案取决于你如何处理这些问题。
The most straightforward approach is to assume that the world will continue to want evermore meat.
最直截了当的方法是假设世界将继续想要更多的肉。
The United Nations’ best guess is that by 2050, the world will need to more than double its production of meat, an increase that would be environmentally disastrous.
联合国的最佳猜测是，到2050年，世界的肉类产量将翻一番以上，这一增长将对环境造成灾难性的影响。

paragraphs.brief: 当然，这并没有考虑到动物福利问题，因为集约耕作通常意味着生活条件差和使用生长激素。
sentences: Under this scenario the goal will have to be producing the most meat at the lowest environmental cost.
在这一设想下，目标必须是以最低的环境成本生产最多的肉类。
According to Walter Falcon, an agricultural economist, this means fewer free range cattle and sheep in green fields.
根据农业经济学家Walter Falcon的说法，这意味着绿地中免费放牧的牛和羊较少。
‘If you’re going to keep some livestock systems, I think the ones you’ll want to keep are the intensive ones,’ he says.
我想你会想要的是那些紧张的，'他说：“如果你要保留一些牲畜系统。”
Of course this does not take into account animal welfare issues, as intensive farming usually means poor living conditions and the use of growth hormones.
当然，这并没有考虑到动物福利问题，因为集约耕作通常意味着生活条件差和使用生长激素。

items.en: the suggestion that people may need to adapt to a different quality of meat
items.zh: 建议人们可能需要适应不同质量的肉类
items.why: E段指出若推广这种饲养方式，人们要适应脂肪更少的鸡肉等，因而饮食偏好也得调整。

items.en: a description of the way animals were fed in the past
items.zh: 描述过去喂养动物的方式
items.why: 题干关键词 "in the past” “the way animals fed” 对应“For most of human history" 和“grazed on land*,具体描述的是: 过去家畜主要靠在栅将土地上吃草来获取食物。故选 D。

items.en: a prediction in regard to human demand for meat
items.why: H段引述联合国对2050年的预测，认为全球需要的肉类产量将不止翻倍。

items.en: the potential consequences of a meat-free world for textile industries
items.zh: 无肉世界对纺织业的潜在影响
items.why: 题二中的“textile industries”指的是纺织/服装行业，对应文中“leather…wool…turned into clothing"。如果世界不再养畜，就要蔡代这些纺织原料，这是对纺织业的潜在后果。故选 F。

items.en: Agriculture causes significant harm to the environment in a number of ways, including the frequent use of ________ in modern farming and the cutting down of trees.
items.zh: 农业以多种方式严重影响环境，例如现代农业频繁使用________，以及为了耕作而砍伐树木。
items.why: 回到对应内容“例如，砍伐森林和共同使用灌溉系统”，再按题干要求写出答案。

items.en: It is also responsible for the production of many greenhouse gases, more so than ________ is.
items.zh: 农业还排放大量温室气体，排放量甚至超过________。
items.why: 回到对应内容“农业产生的温室气体超过所有运输方法的总和可能会令你感到惊讶”，再按题干要求写出答案。

items.en: A meat-free diet would mean that actually less ________ could be used for crops.
items.zh: 如果改吃无肉饮食，实际上可用于种植作物的________反而会减少。
items.why: 回到对应内容“总之，如果我们改吃素食，也就是说没有肉、奶或鸡蛋，目前种植作物所需的土地估计将减少21%，大约340万公顷，大约相当于印度面积”，再按题干要求写出答案。

items.en: Far less chemical pollution, specifically in the form of ________, would also be released into the environment, especially if consumers cut out dairy and egg products as well as meat.
items.zh: 排放到环境中的化学污染物也会大幅减少，尤其是________。如果人们在戒肉的同时也不吃奶制品和蛋类，这一效果会更加明显。
items.why: 回到对应内容“减少畜牧业也会减少对环境的影响，其中一个影响是农业过程排放的氮，这种氮会扩散到水路和土地”，再按题干要求写出答案。

items.en: In the US, there is clear evidence that considerable ________ is caused by the demand for grazing land, although there is no information on this from other countries.
items.zh: 在美国，有明确证据表明，对放牧用地的需求导致了大量________。其他国家尚无这方面的数据。
items.why: 美国的数据指出牲畜饲养占到相当比例的侵蚀，主要原因是开林辟牧场。全球统计则难以获取。

groups.instructionsZh: 先回想空格里的英文。每空填一个词。

items.en: It is not possible to say that a vegetarian diet is right for everyone.
items.zh: 不能说素食对每个人都是合适的。

items.en: It may be economically preferable to farm animals in limited space.
items.zh: 在经济上比在有限空间养殖动物更为可取。

items.en: It does not make sense to give up meat without giving up dairy products too.
items.zh: 放弃肉类而不放弃奶制品也是没有道理的。

items.en: Some animals can be fed in a way that allows waste to be recycled.
items.zh: 有些动物可以允许废物回收的方式进食。

points: H段引述联合国对2050年的预测，认为全球需要的肉类产量将不止翻倍。
回到对应内容“总之，如果我们改吃素食，也就是说没有肉、奶或鸡蛋，目前种植作物所需的土地估计将减少21%，大约340万公顷，大约相当于印度面积”，再按题干要求写出答案。
clauses: To find out, let’s imagine …, then trace the effects.
“what would happen if the world eliminated meat, milk and eggs from its diet”补足 imagine 的内容，交代究竟在说、判断或发现什么。
先读 imagine 所在的主句，再把 if 后面的内容作为一个整体。
In part, that is …, and farmers are forced to grow more than we would otherwise need to meet the demand.
连接词 because 引出“because most livestock eat grain that could be used to feed human populations”，说明主句的原因关系。
先读主句的动作，再用 because 把这一层关系补进去。
lead: Some claim that it’s the only way to save our planet from disaster.
有些人声称这是拯救地球免遭灾难的唯一途径。
But is it really that simple?
